caption:
The word “planet” comes from Greek. It means “wandering star”.

Planets shift against the fixed stars. From Earth, they can seem to meet.
A meeting is called a conjunction. It is not chance. Physics rules it.
In the APOD, Venus sat near the star Spica, about 250 light-years away.

What the astronomers say: In 1890 they found Spica is two blue stars that orbit each other every 4 days, and this year a report says it has a third star.
